pro.title: Pro feature
pro.successDesc: Everything unlocked — thanks for supporting the app.
pro.pendingDesc: This can take a few seconds. If it lags, just refresh the status.

billing.title: Plan
billing.freeDesc: You're on the free plan. Pro unlocks Family Access, advanced reports and projection.
billing.activeDesc: Thanks for supporting! Everything in Pro is unlocked.
billing.cancelingDesc: Subscription canceled — no data is lost. Pro stays active until the date below; after that your account automatically returns to the free plan.

phrases: The future is built one contribution at a time.
Every dollar invested today is freedom down the road.
Small steps now, big leaps later.
Wealth isn't luck — it's a habit.

common.autoHint: The current month is captured automatically from your net worth — and the contribution comes from your budget's monthly savings. Edit any row to take it over.

dashboard.trendEmpty: The trend line appears with 2 or more months of history.
dashboard.emptyDesc: Add your net worth and budget — your numbers show up here, always encrypted on your device.
dashboard.step1: Add your wealth — assets, investments and debts

patrimonio.noAssetsDesc: Add your investments, properties and accounts to see your net worth.
patrimonio.noLiabilitiesDesc: Loans, financing and cards go here.
patrimonio.name: Name
patrimonio.tickerHint: Fill in Ticker, Qty and Avg. price — the value auto-updates from the daily quote and shows your return.
patrimonio.emptyAssets: Add your first asset by choosing a class.
patrimonio.tipEmpty: Add assets to see your net worth.
patrimonio.errAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

debt.title: Debt payoff
debt.withoutPlan: {{n}} debt(s) without a term aren't scheduled.
debt.hint: Estimate with equal installments (amortized), from the balance, annual rate and remaining payments.

orcamento.recurringHint: Mark fixed entries (rent, salary, subscriptions) with ↻ — they flow into the next months on their own.
orcamento.historyHint: Tap a bar to open that month

historico.tipEmpty: Track net worth to watch it evolve.
historico.reconcileHint: You saved more in your budget than your net worth grew. That surplus isn't in your assets yet — you likely still need to invest it or record where the money is. It clears on its own once your net worth reflects it.
historico.autoHint: The current month is captured automatically from your net worth and keeps itself updated. Edit any row to take it over.

objetivos.tipEmpty: Set goals and track your progress.

investimentos.hint: Set a target % per class; rebalancing shows how much to buy or sell to get there.

projecao.fromNetWorth: Investable wealth — base of the whole projection
projecao.sensitivityDesc: Years to independence as you vary annual return and monthly contribution.
projecao.sensitivityEmpty: Add your expenses in Budget to compute how far you are from independence.
projecao.sensitivityReached: Your wealth already covers your independence number — nothing to project here.

fire.title: Financial independence
fire.subtitle: ≈ {{mult}}× your annual expenses
fire.empty: Add your spending in Budget (or enter it below) to see how much wealth would sustain your lifestyle.
fire.hint: Estimate in today's money (real return of the base scenario). The 4% rule is a starting point, not investment advice.

montecarlo.title: Probability of success
montecarlo.subtitle: Monte Carlo simulation: thousands of market paths with ups and downs, not a single average.
montecarlo.empty: Add your spending in Budget (or your cost at independence) to simulate the probabilities.
montecarlo.accumTitle: Accumulation — chance of reaching your FIRE number
montecarlo.accumHeadline: {{pct}}% chance of reaching independence in {{years}} years
montecarlo.accumNote: Probability that your investable wealth reaches your FIRE number within the projection horizon.
montecarlo.accumReached: You've already reached your FIRE number — accumulation is complete.
montecarlo.retireHeadline: {{pct}}% chance of lasting {{years}} years in retirement
montecarlo.retireNote: Starting from your FIRE number and withdrawing your cost of living (in today's money) under volatile returns — sequence-of-returns risk.

liberdade.title: Freedom
liberdade.heroNote: wealth on the way to your independence
liberdade.headline: You're {{pct}}% of the way to freedom
liberdade.subtitle: ≈ {{mult}}× your annual cost
liberdade.coveredByPassive: Your passive income already covers your cost — you don't depend on the portfolio.
liberdade.tipEmpty: Add expenses and net worth to see how far you are.
liberdade.empty: Add your spending in Budget and your wealth to see how far you are from independence.
liberdade.streakHint: Consecutive months in the black (income above spending).
liberdade.streakEmpty: Close a month in the black to start your streak.

cfg.basisHint: Everything here is yours — defaults are only a starting point. The withdrawal rate and contribution/return come from Projection.
cfg.targetCostHint: Empty/0 = uses your current cost (from the budget). Set a monthly amount to plan freedom around your FUTURE cost of living, different from today's (e.g. moving out, marriage, kids).
cfg.eligibleHint: Which classes count toward your freedom. Real estate and physical goods are off by default (they don't produce drawable income); turn on what does (e.g. a rental property).
cfg.passiveHint: Income categories that offset your cost (you need less portfolio). Default: rent. Don't tick dividends/interest — those already come from your portfolio.
cfg.milestonesHint: Values that trigger an achievement. Left empty, we suggest an automatic ladder.
cfg.milestonesAuto: No milestones set — using an automatic suggestion.

health.title: Financial health
health.empty: Add wealth, budget or goals to compute your financial health.
health.hint: A 0–100 score weighing savings, diversification, reserve, debt and goal progress.

cfg.hint: Weights and thresholds are yours. Dimensions with no data are ignored and weights renormalize.

proventos.title: Dividends
proventos.hint: Log dividends, interest-on-equity and REIT income received (source, month YYYY-MM and amount). Yield is the last 12 months' income over total invested.

crossborder.fxHint: You hold wealth in more than one currency. When exchange rates move, your net worth (in your main currency) moves with them. See your exposure and sensitivity.
crossborder.fxHintSingle: All your wealth is in {{base}} — you have no FX exposure. When exchange rates move, your total doesn't change. Add an asset in another currency to see the sensitivity.
crossborder.fxEmpty: Add assets to see your FX exposure.
crossborder.sensitivityHint: If foreign currencies appreciate or depreciate {{pct}}% against your main currency.
crossborder.tipEmpty: Add assets in another currency to see FX exposure.

data.exportCsvDesc: Flat spreadsheet (assets, expenses, income…) to open in Excel/Sheets.

support.intro: Need help or want to reach us? Open a ticket — I'll reply right here.
support.emptyDesc: Questions, problems, suggestions — open a ticket and we'll talk right here.
support.subject: Subject
support.subjectPh: Sum it up in one line
support.closedNote: This ticket was marked resolved. Open a new one if you need.
support.notE2ee: Support messages live on our server (not end-to-end encrypted like your data). Don't include passwords, your recovery code, or account numbers.
support.errFields: Fill in the subject and add a message or image.
support.attachError: Couldn't attach the image (use PNG/JPG/WebP, up to 3 MB).
